description: This file is a C# source code file defining extension methods for configuring hosting and application services in an ASP.NET Core environment, including OpenTelemetry, health checks, service discovery, and HTTP resilience.

classes.name: Extensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for setting up common application services such as health checks, OpenTelemetry, and service discovery.

methods.name: AddServiceDefaults
methods.description: Configures default services including OpenTelemetry, health checks, service discovery, and HTTP resilience.

methods.name: ConfigureOpenTelemetry
methods.description: Sets up logging and metrics collection via OpenTelemetry, including instrumentation for ASP.NET Core, HTTP clients, and runtime metrics.

methods.name: AddOpenTelemetryExporters
methods.description: Configures the export of telemetry data, supporting OTLP exporter and optionally Azure Monitor.

methods.name: AddDefaultHealthChecks
methods.description: Adds health check endpoints for liveness and readiness probes.

methods.name: MapDefaultEndpoints
methods.description: Maps health check endpoints to the web application, conditional on environment being development.
